name: Flipt
description: Flipt is a Git-native feature flag and remote configuration platform. Flags, segments and rollouts are stored as files in a Git repository and managed through a web UI or the REST and gRPC APIs, with OpenFeature support and SDKs for many languages.

notes.text: Sign in to the web UI with the admin user and password from /opt/flipt_data/.env.
API and SDK clients authenticate with API_TOKEN from /opt/flipt_data/.env as a Bearer token, over HTTP on port 8080 or gRPC on port 9000.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: Web UI login for the user admin, generated when left empty

app_vars.name: var_api_key
app_vars.label: API Token
app_vars.help: Bearer token for API and SDK clients, letters and digits only, generated when left empty
